evidence: The chemical composition and the impurity level were analyzed by X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (XPS) using an Al K/H9251 monochromatic source of 1486.6 eV. The thickness of the films was measured by spectroscopic ellipsometry. The electrical properties including capacitive–voltage (C–V) and current–voltage (I–V) characteristics were evaluated with a Keithley 590 C-V analyzer and an Agilent 4155C semiconductor parameter analyzer.
